scope: One test-only bound-calculation optimization, two new bounded diagnostic harnesses and evidence/relay updates. No runtime or existing test edits.

cost.method: Same capacity-valid fixtures, Node24.19/V8, sequential uninstrumented 20 warmup+100 measured frames. All5 cows evolve. Includes displayed-copy/query/disposal, excludes ordinary animation/controller/rendering. Finite sample, no worst-case proof or phone extrapolation.

allocations.method: Separate V8 16KiB allocation sampling with collected objects included. Query attribution follows cowSweptQuery only. Copy attribution includes both timed collision displayed-copy and untimed fixture displayed-state capture; not an exact timed-copy allocation count. Sampling changes timing and is excluded from cost comparison.

memory.note: Post-GC retained deltas, not exact ownership accounting. heapBeforeFinalGC is one observation, not peak process memory. Allocation profiler retention is excluded.

projectBudget.decision: Do not integrate yet: 61% of ideal frame budget for this subsystem on desktop plus substantial allocation pressure; no full browser/frame or physical-phone measurement. No numeric subsystem threshold invented.

remaining: Gameplay A20 unchanged, care/wake1/30, physical safetyRED; broad matrix paused. Exact animated browser replays, live support integration and full authored bed/robot approaches remain prior blockers. No new proof gate. No uploads, Site update, merge or deployment.
